note: Published *stated* Political-Compass-Test placements of open-weight LLM families (or close predecessors) overlapping our sweep, plus the two anchor papers. Coordinates are the PCT's own compass units (economic: left-/right+, social: libertarian-/authoritarian+), NOT our nats of log-odds. Sources are primary where possible: Rozado's Zenodo tabulated_results.csv (per-model means over 10 retakes), the PolAlign audit's arXiv HTML Table 8/16, the Gemma3/Qwen3 perturbation study's GitHub configuration CSV, and Rottger et al.'s HTML text. Quadrant-only or figure-only results carry null coordinates with the placement in notes.
matching_rule: A literature entry matches one of our models when the family name and (where the source has more than one size) the nearest parameter count coincide; each of our families is matched to its closest tested relative otherwise (e.g. our Ministral 3 -> Mistral 7B Instruct). See literature_compare.py MATCH for the exact model-by-model assignment.
